author: Dwayner77
quote:
Absolutely the worst JOYSTICK controls EVER! CRINGY goal animations. (I mean REAL CRINGY) Gameplay is garbage again with garbage puck physics as it has been since NHL 10. Here is your typical NHL 24 **** PLAYER shoots puck, hits glass behind net, bounces off of the guys head, off of another players knob of his stick, off of the score board and in! %75 of the goals in this game you just shake your head at how bad of the physics are. Can't even do basic simple D to D passes without a pass somehow going into your own net after a screw up bounce...
Taking away CLASSIC CONTROLS when nobody ask for this makes me angrier then ever when it comes to the lack of EA. Creating a new set of controls which is very similar to skill stick which I personally hated from day one! There was ZERO REASON to get rid of these controls or the BASIC EA 3 button controls for the beginners such as my child as I have Been playing these games since Sega and I own every single one going all the way back to EA NHLPA for my Sega. 

Cant count the number of times my guys been on breakaways, go to deke and shoot but the dummy JUMPS for some reason! (Yes I know how to play skill stick), next I pass many times to my Defencemen wide open as he walks in... then he JUMPS the puck, they come down and score over and over.  Trying to fire a rocket pass to far side to wide open teammates however my other teammates always picks off the wrong passes! When playing against the computer they will mysteriously make every single pass, even though you have every direction of the passing lane blocked, they never fail. The deking and stick handling is pure junk as it has been since roughly NHL 16. Why would you create a whole new combo of controls that makes no sense when they are similar skill stick anyways? Classic controls where great as you could still use both analog or the buttons! I'm sick of breaking these joysticks over faceoffs and shots. Who asked for all these dummy moves you added in the new set of controls in which you couldn't use in real hockey anyways? 9 out of 10 times you would get laid out! taking away the simple pass, shoot, hit buttons for stupid things such as passing through legs and stuff is uncalled for! how many controls are needed now for hits? its ridiculous. 

AI is still as stupid as ever! Cant count the number of times my teammate computer skated backwords into my own goalie or beside the goalie when allowing the computer to just walk from the slot every time. The gameplay feels clunky! forces you into hits many times. Skating still feels like crap, not as smooth as it should be. Every other game the glass breaks, turn the sliders down. Can you please turn the annoying pressure system off or at least give us the options of shutting it off! this isn't anything new! All EA does is add cool things, take away things then re-add things down the road! 

Extremely slow loading times is also annoying in this game. Rosters have not been updated as it still has players on old teams prior to July 1st! The games way to bright as you cant even see the ice half the time, I've worked in arena's over 25 years and never seen ice that bright from lights. Also this is a video game so keep the Politics out of the Damm game as it should be fun! Put the RUSSIAN INTERNATIONAL teams back into this game. Ever since2K stopped making NHL games, EA has been extremely lazy! All they focus on is HUT where they make their money the most! I've always said if the gameplay is GARBAGE, the game is GARBAGE! This years version is no exception! Everything about this game is garbage!
